VERSUS  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH Respondent(
 Date : 21-02-2023 This petition was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S. RAVINDRA BHAT  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DIPANKAR DATTA

For Petitioner(s) Ms. Vanshaja Shukla, AOR  Mr. Naman Mishra, Adv.
 Mr. Abhishek Chaterjee, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) Mr. Mrinal Elkar Mazumdar, Adv.
 Mr. Aakash Nadolia, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R
The petitioner is aggrieved by the denial of bail to him.
He is accused of committing offences punishable under Sections 420, 120-B IPC and Section 66-C and 66-D of Information Technology Act.
The petitioner has been in custody for almost a year.

Having regard to the circumstances of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the petitioner Amrit Kumar Das vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110639339/
1 should be enlarged on bail.
